title: verus-docker chain metadata
description: OPTIONAL convenience metadata for a Verus chain. This directory is never a whitelist: any chain name works without an entry here. An entry only supplies things the container cannot discover on its own, such as a bootstrap URL or a conventional port assignment.

name.description: The chain name as passed to verusd -chain=.

kind.description: root = VRSC, testnet = VRSCTEST, pbaas = a chain launched on top of a root chain.

currencyid.description: The chain's i-address on its root chain.

datadir_hash.description: For PBaaS chains: the hex directory name verusd derives under <home>/pbaas/. Documentation only; the daemon creates it.

ports.description: Default ports. For VRSC and VRSCTEST these are the daemon's compiled-in values and cannot be changed with -port. For PBaaS chains the daemon derives an unpredictable P2P port from the chain definition, so these are a convention this project applies via -port and -rpcport.

url.description: Bootstrap archive URL. A <url>.sha256sum sidecar must exist next to it; verus-docker refuses to download an archive it cannot verify.

signer.description: The VerusID that publishes this bootstrap. Not all bootstraps come from the Verus Coin Foundation — record who you are trusting.

tls_note.description: Set when the host has known TLS problems.
